high_level_description: This image is a humorous meme that plays on the idea of choosing a favorite Hayao Miyazaki film. The top part of the image features three movie posters for films directed by Hayao Miyazaki: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind: The poster shows Nausicaä standing with her back to the viewer, looking out over a landscape with a large insect-like creature behind her. Castle in the Sky: This poster depicts two characters, one in a red outfit and another in a blue outfit, hanging from a rope or cable, with a cityscape in the background.
